item.title: ▫️ ‘The enemy was trying to repel desperately, but we managed to do that, to liberate Dobropolye’
item.description: ▫️ ‘The enemy was trying to repel desperately, but we managed to do that, to liberate Dobropolye’ 💬 Servicemen of the 51st Combined Arms Army (the Tsentr Group of Forces) revealed new details about the liberation of Dobropolye in the Donetsk People's Republic. 🤝 The success of the operation was the result of the Russian Army's coordinated actions: 🔥 The fire support of the 114th Brigade's artillery division created conditions for assault groups to advance. Artillerymen promptly suppressed the enemy's firing positions, covered the manoeuvres, and prohibited the AFU's units to regroup. ⚡️ The 80th Battalion's reconnaissance groups laid the foundation for planning the entire operation. They revealed the enemy's resistance points and escape routes. The continuous flow of reconnaissance data allowed the command to make decisions quickly. 🎮 The 56th Special Battalion actively used UAVs to control the situation. They were looking for routes, spotted ambushes, and adjusted assault detachments. This helped to cover our positions and maintain the offensive actions' high pace. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🩺 Real Guardian Angels Military doctors of the 44th Army Corps (the Sever Group of Forces) continue to provide medical assistance in the special military operation zone.
item.description: Real Guardian Angels 🩺 Military doctors of the 44th Army Corps (the Sever Group of Forces) continue to provide medical assistance in the special military operation zone. ▫️ Resuscitationists are the first ones who accept heavily wounded patients, stabilise them, and prepare them to be evacuated. Why do Russian servicemen get back into action so quickly? The key secret is speed. Often, the wounded are evacuated on fast motor vehicles and ground robots. ❗️ They have to operate in difficult conditions, under constant threat from enemy drones. But forward groups' medics perform their job in spite of the risks. We thank you a lot for every saved soldier! 🙏 ❤️ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ‘ Andrei Belousov says to the guards paratroopers, who captured the settlement of Yulyevka:
item.description: Andrei Belousov says to the guards paratroopers, who captured the settlement of Yulyevka: this victory continues the heroic path and glorious traditions of the Airborne Troops Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the command and personnel of the 328th Guards Air Assault Regiment on the liberation of the settlement of Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region). ‘ The paratroopers, displaying courage and valor in difficult battles with the enemy in Orekhov direction, continue to build upon the glorious traditions of the heroes and soldiers of past years ,’ said the Russian Defence Minister. 🤝 Andrei Belousov thanked the servicemen for the successful accomplishment of combat tasks and their fidelity to military duty, and also expressed confidence that the personnel of the unit will continue to serve Russia with honour and reliably ensure its security. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30201

item.title: 🏳️ Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’
item.description: 🏳️ Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’ A captured Ukrainian serviceman, Anatoly Kropotov, told about the command's total indifference to the servicemen: ‘We didn't have any training, all we had is a few days of dry fire trainings. They wanted to send us to the frontline ASAP. The only mentioned reason was insufficient manpower there. The brigade commander sends us with some rancour, he doesn't send food supplies, servicemen are starving and killing each other to get some food, to try to survive.’ Leaving the AFU's encircled formations defeated in Dobropolye, the Tsentr Group's servicemen continue to neutralise Ukrainian militants on the line of contact. The only chance to stay alive is to surrender to the Russian servicemen. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30198

🏳️
Hell in AFU trenches: ‘People are starving and kill each other to get some food’
A captured Ukrainian serviceman, Anatoly Kropotov, told about the command's total indifference to the servicemen:
‘We didn't have any training, all we had is a few days of dry fire trainings. They wanted to send us to the frontline ASAP. The only mentioned reason was insufficient manpower there. The brigade commander sends us with some rancour, he doesn't send food supplies, servicemen are starving and killing each other to get some food, to try to survive.’
Leaving the AFU's encircled formations defeated in Dobropolye, the Tsentr Group's servicemen continue to neutralise Ukrainian militants on the line of contact.
The only chance to stay alive is to surrender to the Russian servicemen.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
